closed.description: `true` when every window of the instance was closed (or the connection dropped, see [`Self::disconnected`]). The browser process is expected to exit.

disconnected.description: `true` when the extension's reply never arrived because its WebSocket dropped — i.e. the browser went away while closing. The daemon reports success in that case; `windows_closed` may then under-report.

sessions_stopped.description: Sessions that were stopped so their Agent Windows did not leak.

windows_closed.description: Windows the extension closed before replying.
